page.notes: The Greek word after "interdum" is printed small and is hard to read. I have given my best reading and marked it [?]. The word "menfiu" is also doubtful and marked [?]; it may be an abbreviated form of "menstruo". The running head is printed as "CAVSAS" and is given here as CAUSAS, with u/v normalised. "accesio" is printed without the double s and is left as printed. The catchword "cum" is at the foot right and is not repeated in the text.
